Creekview Apartments in Sherman, TX ~ Spacious 1 & 2 Bedrooms with Convenient Amenities

Welcome Home

Discover Creekview Apartments, an expertly managed and service-oriented community presenting seven unique 1 and 2 bedroom floor plans. Our residences boast a range of amenities, including fully-equipped kitchens with dishwashers and built-in microwaves. The spacious walk-in closets, and convenient washer/dryer connections add to your comfortable lifestyle.

Set against beautifully landscaped surroundings, our resort-style pool, inviting hot tub, state-of-the-art fitness center, and much more create an unparalleled community experience. Elevate your living experience and call us today to have the life you’ve always envisioned at Creekview Apartments.
